Scene and Smart Scene Endpoints

Source: R/api-scenes.R
hue_scenes.Rd

Manage and recall static/dynamic scenes (/clip/v2/resource/scene) and time-based all-day smart scenes (/clip/v2/resource/smart_scene) on a Philips Hue Bridge v2 or Bridge Pro.

Usage

hue_get_scenes(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_scene(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_create_scene(body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_update_scene(id, body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_delete_scene(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_recall_scene(
  id,
  action = c("active", "dynamic_palette", "static"),
  duration = NULL,
  brightness = NULL,
  bridge = NULL,
  tidy = TRUE
)

hue_get_smart_scenes(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_smart_scene(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_create_smart_scene(body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_update_smart_scene(id, body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_delete_smart_scene(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_recall_smart_scene(
  id,
  action = c("activate", "deactivate"),
  bridge = NULL,
  tidy = TRUE
)

Arguments

bridge

Optional hue_bridge object created by hue_bridge(). If NULL, resolves from session defaults set by hue_auth() or environment variables.

tidy

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default), returns a tibble parsed via jsonlite. If FALSE, returns the raw parsed R list.

id

Character scalar. UUID of the scene or smart scene resource.

body

Named list representing the CLIP API v2 JSON payload.

action

Character scalar recall action. For hue_recall_scene(), one of "active", "dynamic_palette", or "static". For hue_recall_smart_scene(), one of "activate" or "deactivate".

duration

Optional non-negative integer transition duration in milliseconds for hue_recall_scene().

brightness

Optional numeric scalar in [0, 100] overriding scene dimming brightness during recall.

Value

A tibble (or list when tidy = FALSE) containing the bridge response data array.

Details

Supported CLIP API v2 endpoints:

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/scene — hue_get_scenes()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/scene/{id} — hue_get_scene()

  • POST /clip/v2/resource/scene — hue_create_scene()

  • PUT /clip/v2/resource/scene/{id} — hue_update_scene(), hue_recall_scene()

  • DELETE /clip/v2/resource/scene/{id} — hue_delete_scene()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/smart_scene — hue_get_smart_scenes()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/smart_scene/{id} — hue_get_smart_scene()

  • POST /clip/v2/resource/smart_scene — hue_create_smart_scene()

  • PUT /clip/v2/resource/smart_scene/{id} — hue_update_smart_scene(), hue_recall_smart_scene()

  • DELETE /clip/v2/resource/smart_scene/{id} — hue_delete_smart_scene()

See also

hue_get_rooms(), hue_get_zones(), hue_get_lights()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
scenes <- hue_get_scenes()
hue_recall_scene(scenes$id[[1]], action = "active", duration = 500)
} # }
